texto_aprovado: Under the treaty, Canada has to help in a big flood whenever the United States asks, and the United States covers what that help costs. That's what it means to have Canada on call.

citacoes_relidas.trecho: Canada shall, when called upon by an entity designated by the United States of America for that purpose, operate within the limits of existing facilities any storage in the Columbia River basin in Canada
Canada would be responsible for making these changes. In exchange, the United States would pay for operating costs and economic losses in Canada due to the changed operation.
only to control potential floods in the United States of America that could not be adequately controlled by all the related storage facilities in the United States of America
